content.short: AGNI is a high-capital efficiency AMM-based DEX and token launchpad built natively for the Mantle Network ecosystem.
content.description: AGNI is a decentralized exchange on Mantle that uses a concentrated liquidity AMM model with multiple fee tiers and pool configurations to maximize capital efficiency for liquidity providers. The protocol enables tight fee spreads optimized for different asset types from stablecoins to volatile pairs. AGNI also includes a native launchpad component enabling new Mantle projects to bootstrap their token liquidity directly through the platform at launch.
